## #21 — Joel — 2016-07-11
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/11922/post-102095>

Polygon To Spline tip

One important step to remember is to use the Tools — Coord System — Burn transform. In the attached picture, I started with a default cube, then moved, rotated and scaled it. When I dragged it into the "guide target" box per ZooHead, I got the result on the left. After I burned the transform, the spline object appeared where expected, as on the right.

This is my favorite script. Thanks again to Hiroto.

Attachments: [burn_transform.jpg](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/29287/)
